title: Nonempty fixed-width increment output
statement: For every bit string $w$, if its fixed-width little-endian binary increment produces an output, that output is not the empty word.
replaced: Consider the fixed-width little-endian binary increment, which sends a bit string $w$ to its successor among the words of length $|w|$, or fails (overflow) when $w$ consists only of ones, the empty word included. For every bit string $w$, the increment of $w$ is never the empty word.
